evidence.claim: Flagged transaction 3478782 is an online CNP purchase of $292.36 with risk score 0.79 and empty device metadata.
Only 1 transaction on card C11891-K1 in the 48-hour window around the flagged event.
Card C11891-K1 shows subsequent card-testing behavior in Dec 2016 with rapid small transactions using varying emails.
Device neighbors query returned null device_id for this transaction.
Card C11891-K1 shares 17 device profiles with 8 connected cards across 7 other customers, indicating a fraud ring.
Similar closed cases for card_not_present_fraud consistently resolve as confirmed fraud.
Policy requires VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER or STEP_UP_AUTH before blocking when p < 0.7; here p >= 0.7 so direct block is permitted per R1.

case.summary: Transaction 3478782 on card C11891-K1 scored 0.79. Investigation revealed the card is linked to 8 other cards across 7 customers via 17 shared device profiles, strongly suggesting a coordinated fraud ring. Subsequent card history shows testing behavior. Fraud probability assessed at 0.85 based on multiple independent evidence signals including shared devices and post-flag testing pattern.
